name: shipment-carrier-rate-watch
title: Shipment Carrier Rate Watch
description: Parse FedEx, UPS and DHL published rate tables and surcharge pages - each rate table parsed into normalized rows with fuel and residential surcharges for logistics cost benchmarking.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Shipment Carrier Rate Watch
input.description: Parse FedEx, UPS and DHL published rate tables and surcharge pages - each rate table parsed into normalized rows with fuel and residential surcharges for logistics cost benchmarking.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

include_surcharges.title: Include surcharges
include_surcharges.description: Also parse surcharge and accessorials pages.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
